threshold.passRequires: zero major errors and at most 2 minor errors per 1000 words across the full key set, verified by a native-speaker reviewer

note: A locale flips to reviewed/production-qualified ONLY after a named native-speaker reviewer signs the entry above with reviewerId + reviewedAt + mqmScore meeting the threshold. Until then the completion register keeps nativeReviewStatus=not_native_reviewed. Nothing in this file is auto-marked.
